Character count: {text.length}

`$inspect(text)` at the top level is a reactive statement, so it re-runs (and logs) whenever `text` changes. `$inspect(...).with(fn)` replaces the default `console.log` with your custom callback. `$inspect.trace()` inside `$effect` reports the reactive dependencies (here, `text`) that the effect tracks.

Current text: "{text}"

Character count: {text.length}

Notes: - `$inspect(text)` and `$inspect(text).with(...)` are placed at the top level of the component so they attach to the reactive `text` state. - `$inspect.trace()` must live inside a tracked context (here an `$effect`); the returned `trace` function logs a labeled message whenever called. - The `char-count` paragraph is a derived value — Svelte 5 auto-tracks the dependency on `text` in the template, so it updates automatically.
